title: Issues with Export/Import to DXF for Lectra Modaris and Gerber
content:
TL/DR: Suppliers can't open my DXF exports from the most recent CLO versions, the last version that works is ver. 2024.2.328 (February 26, 2025). That version also has various problems in the exports detailed below. Has anyone had success exporting DXFs for use in Lectra Modaris and Gerber? Please let me know if there are any import/export settings that I or my suppliers are missing that will help us. Thank you!

Full Post: I have been having issues with exporting to dxf, both AAMA and ASTM, for use in Gerber Accumark, Optitex, and Lectra Modaris programs with suppliers. These issues are present in the DXF exports from the most recent versions of CLO:

  * Gerber cannot open files exported from the latest CLO versions at all: issue with piece perimeter missing (screenshot below)

  * ![106187d2b19d4493b563e7c12eca7253](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202601/5d0dee24ec86494a83eaa92fc6626900/images/106187d2b19d4493b563e7c12eca7253Gerber_CLO_Import_Issue.jpg)

  * Optitex cannot open files exported from the latest CLO versions: issue with incorrect scale.

  * Lectra Modaris does not maintain pattern arrangement/marker from CLO file-- the pattern pieces are scattered around the user interface and not in the positions I placed them. 

  * Lectra Modaris shows all lines (cut lines, internal lines, baselines) as cut lines. 




The most recent previous version of CLO that I found that exported something these programs could open was ver. 2024.2.328 (February 26, 2025). The following issues are present in dxf exports from that version:

  * Missing, undersized, or duplicate Notches (not all notches in a file, seemingly at random).

  * Duplicate internal/baselines in DXF exports-- these duplicate both the existing internal lines, AND there are additional internal/baselines copying the cut lines on all shapes. The files I am using are not meant to have seam allowance or grading, just cut lines and internal lines, and sometimes some baselines. 

  * Lectra Modaris does not maintain pattern arrangement/marker from CLO file-- the pattern pieces are scattered around the user interface and not in the positions I placed them. 

  * Lectra Modaris shows all lines (cut lines, internal lines, baselines) as cut lines. 




Please let me know if there is anything I can do on my end when exporting or anything my suppliers could easily do on their end for importing that would mitigate some of these issues. Thank you all!

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi there, we're sorry about the inconvenience! Please share an affected DXF to tech support so they can determine the cause: https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/5d0dee24ec86494a83eaa92fc6626900 I can find no current reports of this extent so it it doesn't appear to be a systemic issue.
content_description: This webpage serves as a resource for troubleshooting DXF export issues from CLO for use in Gerber, Optitex, and Lectra Modaris, seeking community insights on effective export/import settings and solutions.

title: specific measurement box not appearing
content:
Hi there,  
I'm new to Clo3D and I'm learning how to use it with all the youtube videos.  
I am having a problem with features that no longer seem to be up to date in version 2025.2. All the tutorials explain that you can enter precise measurements with the polygon tools by right-clicking. A box is supposed to open to enter the precise measurements you want, but when I do this, I only get a drop-down menu. Can anyone explain how I am supposed to find this measurement box?![d1fb58f0111b4e60954d77aaaf8b591e](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202601/44af90f1a9ca4585a44c3ffadd71be3e/images/d1fb58f0111b4e60954d77aaaf8b591eCapture%20d%E2%80%99e%CC%81cran%202026-01-20%20a%CC%80%2010.08.15.png)this is on the tutorial  
![0bd16c4329994d97bb84a896c4ef9d46](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202601/44af90f1a9ca4585a44c3ffadd71be3e/images/0bd16c4329994d97bb84a896c4ef9d46Capture%20d%E2%80%99e%CC%81cran%202026-01-20%20a%CC%80%2009.56.55.png)and this is what i Get when right clicking

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Dear Marie, sorry for the confusion caused! Could you please share where you heard about the right click? It's been a single LEFT click to get the precision box for these tools since I started using CLO (Nov 2018). A right click to input precise values only works for anything that is being dragged with the left mouse button pressed, and not those tools except the Internal Polygon/Line when inputting a line length.

title: Aligning And Saving Annotation Presets
content:
Aligning And Saving Annotation Presets

Question 1) How to align the annotation in the quickest way?

Like In the middle of the selected pattern. (Both vertical and horizontal.)

Can we do this automatically?

Question 2) How to add my brands icon onto the Annotation?

Question 3) I want to create a Annotation Preset in a particular Font, Font Size, Color and including my brands icon to use It on the every pattern I created.

How can I do this?  
Which file format etc.?

How can I import It on the project I work on?

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi, it is only possible to change color, font size and angle, as well as dragging and dropping to another position. But we can add a feature request for font type and measured positioning such as centering, etc. If you want to add your brand's icon, you can do this with an image file by placing it as a graphic (the official CONNECT store also has a logo on the patterns). There are no presets that can be saved and reused for annotating.
Reply 1: Understood. Thank you very much.
content_description: This web page aims to provide users with step-by-step guidance on aligning annotations, adding brand icons, and creating customizable annotation presets for consistent use across their projects.

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi Tina, two possible solutions: (1) Select the seamlines in questions and make their Normal Map "shadow" wider and/or more intense. (2) In the render window, select the render properties and edit the Global Map for seam puckering to be more intense. This will affect all seamlines.

title: Zipper
content: The zippers that come with CLO3D always seem a bit underwhelming, and their size often appears too small to me. When used on the clothes, they can undermine the overall quality of the garments. That's why I've specifically crafted #5 - sized zippers. There are two types, and each type has two closure methods. All the attributes and adjustment methods of these zippers are fully compatible with the software. I typically apply them to the making of down jackets and padded jackets, which endows the clothing with an overall sense of luxury. I've set up UV grid layouts for both the zippers and their pulls, enabling the customization of LOGOs, just as shown in my illustrations. The UV grids are directly incorporated into the normal map of each zipper file, and the file format is.PSD. After downloading, you can click to make modifications. I'm still in the process of continuous exploration, hoping to offer more convenient methods to enthusiasts!![2430ead84cb140e68e6af7a5a9630abd](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202601/15c014faef94469c93dde357b5fc4cb2/images/2430ead84cb140e68e6af7a5a9630abd%E7%AC%AC%E4%BA%8C%E7%89%88.png)

title: How To Remove The Dart On The Trousers Waistline
content:
Tutorial Vidoes show how to draw or shift the dart but they don’t show how to remove the dart.

Can you explain how can I do these pelase?

Step 1) measure the dart base (Let’s say the dart 2 cm)

How to measure the “dart gap” “dart base”?

Step 2) Remove the dart

Step 3) Add 1 cm to each side of the waist line on the Back Trousers Pattern.

Is “Edit Pattern Tool - Offset Pattern Outline” right for this purpose?

![223c5885cc8c4a87830d3a5385f57fbe](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202601/caa21e06026b4a26ab88fedf375689b3/images/223c5885cc8c4a87830d3a5385f57fbeScreenshot%202026-01-16%20at%2018.46.23.png)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Just try out the different ideas you have, if it doesn't work you can just revert the last step :) In this case, "Offset Pattern Outline" will affect the entire segment in a parallel way. If you wish to keep a nice curve instead, on suggestion would be to try moving the outer corners via the Edit Pattern tool by dragging. You can open a precision window for measurements by right-clicking at the same time as you are dragging and holding down the left mouse button. Another way would be to right-click on the segment and choose "Change Length", then putting in the desired measurement.
Reply 1: What about Step 2) How do I remove the dart? I could not do this.
Reply 2: Delete the corner point of the dart inside the pattern piece, then smooth out the waistline (two segment points will remain on it, you can covert them to curve points and go from there).
content_description: Learn how to effectively remove a dart from your pattern by measuring the dart base and adjusting the waistline accordingly.

title: How To Measure Dart Gap With The POM Tool
content:
In Segment Mode when I click on the dart leg points It measures the whole dart. (Measurement of the 2 Dart legs)

But I want to measure the distance between those dart legs. (the gap between them on the waist curve)

On the screenshot It is presented as “here”

How can I do this?

![800b92aaf752445782f9ee3f69b05e07](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202601/dd024be01ff848b8bdfe0b21f18a7b2b/images/800b92aaf752445782f9ee3f69b05e07Screenshot%202026-01-15%20at%2014.54.38.png)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi there, the POM tool skips empty space as you have noted, but there is a way to trick it into measuring a gap. (1) First, create a random POM on the pattern piece. (2) With the Edit POM tool, grab one end and drag and drop it to one side of the gap - the point will be magnetic and snap to it. (3) Do the same with the other end. The gap is now being measured.
Reply 1: https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/dd024be01ff848b8bdfe0b21f18a7b2b some reason the other end of the POM line does not snap to the other edge of the gap.As you see on the screenshot video;???
Reply 2: You still have the entire line selected, not just the point you wish to move. Click in the empty space once to lose the selection, then drag and drop only the point to be moved and it will work :)
Reply 3: Understood. Thank you very much.
content_description: This webpage provides guidance on measuring the gap between dart leg points on a waist curve in Segment Mode.
